title: Feature Request:Restore text-based prediction information in the OpenAPS tab for accessibility
body:
Posting this for a friend: 
Description:
In earlier AndroidAPS versions, the OpenAPS tab provided prediction
information in a text-based format. As a blind user, I was able to access
this information with Android TalkBack.
The text view included prediction information such as IOB, COB, UAM (and
other prediction models when available), as well as the prediction values
themselves. This made it possible to review the predictions without relying
on graphics.
In AndroidAPS 3.4.2.4, this information appears to be available only as a
graphical prediction chart. While the graph is useful for sighted users, it
is not accessible with TalkBack. As a result, screen reader users have lost
access to information that was available in previous versions.
I would like to request that the text-based prediction information be
restored, either below the graph or as an optional accessibility view. This
would not change the existing graphical interface but would make the same
information available again for users who rely on screen readers.
I am not the only person affected. I also help several other blind
AndroidAPS users, and they have the same accessibility issue.
I would be happy to test any implementation with TalkBack and provide
feedback if that would be helpful.
Thank you for considering this request and for all the work on AndroidAPS.

comments.body: v4 will have completely new UI. request specific improvements for v4 (dev now or once released)
